title: Restricted Weights Gating and License Provenance Workflow for Model Catalog
creator: Marco Liu
description: Problem: We need automated, auditable checks during model onboarding that block or flag models with restricted weights, incompatible licenses, or missing provenance metadata before they appear in the public catalog or are available for Dedicated/Private deployments. Current manual review is slow and error-prone and creates accidental exposures.
acceptance_criteria: Automated SPDX-compatible license parser that extracts license identifiers from model metadata (model card, weights manifest, repo).

Policy engine that maps license identifiers and weight provenance signals to one of: allow, allow-with-terms, restrict (requires legal review), block. Policy rules configurable by environment (hosted vs private).
Restricted-weights detection heuristics (signatures, known sources, LFS/weights provenance) and an integration to a denylist + manual verification queue.
Onboarding API returns structured error codes for: LICENSE_RESTRICTED, WEIGHTS_RESTRICTED, PROVENANCE_MISSING, LICENSE_UNKNOWN; console surfaces next steps and links to review artifacts.
Audit log entries for every onboarding attempt including raw manifest snapshot, parsed license, and policy decision, retained per compliance retention policy.
Rollout path: start gating for hosted model submissions (internal only), then mirror rules for Dedicated onboarding with opt-in dry-run telemetry, then enforce for Public catalog.
updates: 2025-02-12: Ticket created after Legal flagged two near-miss model entries during sync from partner repo. Scoped initial work to automated license parsing + denylist checks.

2025-02-14: Eng spike completed (ENG-3021) — prototype SPDX parser + sample manifests. Found ~7 nonstandard license fields across test corpus; agreed to implement fuzzy fallback parsing and source heuristics.

2025-02-16: PM/Legal sync — approved policy draft with three decision buckets and required manual review SLA (48h) for 'restrict' cases. Legal requested explicit telemetry to record reviewer identity and rationale.
2025-02-18: Design requested console copy and an onboarding modal flow for blocked models; created DES-112 to design UX for the manual review queue.

2025-02-19: Engineering proposed two-phase rollout: dry-run telemetry for all incoming models for 2 weeks, then hard block for hosted unless exempted. Assigned to Aisha Patel for rollout coordination.
